verdict.rationale: Honeycomb supports rule-based background automations (Triggers and SLOs that continuously monitor and alert without human intervention) and an API/MCP server that lets AI agents query and investigate telemetry on demand, but there is no evidence of AI-driven agents autonomously running scheduled or continuous background workflows within Honeycomb itself — the MCP integration is described as on-demand investigation, not autonomous background operation. Missing for 10: evidence of AI agents initiating/scheduling autonomous background tasks (not just threshold-based triggers or on-demand queries), and any documented agentic workflow that runs without a live user session.
